data.name: Diqrah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-q-r', meaning 'to seek knowledge'. In Islamic tradition, Diqrah represents a woman who is knowledgeable, wise, and a seeker of truth.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom in life.

in_arabic.name: ديقرہ
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ديقرہ مشتق من الجذر ذ-ك-ر، و يعني الذكر الحسن، الخير، البركة، و تذكر النعم

in_urdu.name: دیقرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: دیقرہ نام کی اصیل عربی جڑ ذ-ك-ر سے نکلی ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اچھائی، برکت، اور اچھے ذکروں کی یادگار، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے یہ نام برکت و خوشحالی کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: दीقرह
in_hindi.long_meaning: दीقرह नाम की जड़ अरबी भाषा में है, जिसका अर्थ है अच्छाई, समृद्धि और अच्छी यादों का प्रतीक, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: ډیقرہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: ډیقرہ نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د نیکمرغۍ، برکت، او ښې یادونو څخه عبارت دی، په افغان او پښتون دود کې دا نوم د پام وړ دی

in_english.name: Diqrah
in_english.meaning: a reminder of good and blessings
in_english.long_meaning: The name Diqrah is derived from the Arabic root 'ذ-ك-ر' (ذِكْر), meaning 'mention', 'remembrance', or 'good repute'. It signifies a token of good, a blessing, or a pleasant memory. Historically, Diqrah has been used in Islamic tradition to express gratitude and commemorate divine favors. The name embodies virtues of remembrance, gratitude, and spiritual reflection.

data.cultural_impact: In many Islamic societies, being educated and knowledgeable is considered an essential aspect of a person's character and thus, Diqrah could be perceived as a symbol of intelligence, dedication, and achievement.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, knowledge is a taqwa (God-consciousness) and a pathway to spiritual enlightenment. As a result, Diqrah represents not only a pursuit of intellectual knowledge, but also an inner spiritual journey towards self-improvement and closeness to Allah (God). Thus, the name Diqrah carries a profound message to constantly seek knowledge, wisdom, and truth, both in this world and the hereafter.
